_comment: Inputs for the monthly snapshot section of the daily channel report. Since 2026-08-26, growth_channels_spend and creative_partnerships_spend are computed LIVE from the Invoices and Payments board (18390740532) on every run (REFRESH_DAILY.md Step 5); this file is their FALLBACK when the board pull fails - keep those two roughly current with an as-of date in the month's _note. seo_spend and slg_arr still come from here every run (no SEO invoices on the board; SLG ARR is not an invoice figure).
